author: Copilot
body: Removing `vllm_omni/deploy/minicpmo_4_5_batching.yaml` is a breaking change for any existing users/scripts referencing that deploy-config path. To preserve backward compatibility, re-add `minicpmo_4_5_batching.yaml` as a thin alias (e.g., `base_config: minicpmo_4_5_2gpu.yaml`) rather than deleting it entirely.

author: Copilot
body: This PR is described as an OOM workaround by reducing batching pressure, but this change increases stage-1 `max_tokens` (512 → 1024), which can increase KV/cache memory and runtime in CI e2e. If this increase is required, please document the rationale in the PR description; otherwise consider keeping the lower value to align with the OOM-mitigation goal.
